class-barbarian.name: Barbarian
class-barbarian.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

class-bard.name: Bard
class-bard.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

class-cleric.name: Cleric
class-cleric.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

class-druid.name: Druid
class-druid.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature.

class-fighter.name: Fighter
class-fighter.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

class-monk.name: Monk
class-monk.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.
proficiencies: One type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument

class-paladin.name: Paladin
class-paladin.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

class-ranger.name: Ranger
class-ranger.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

class-rogue.name: Rogue
class-rogue.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

class-sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
class-sorcerer.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

class-warlock.name: Warlock
class-warlock.description: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

class-wizard.name: Wizard
class-wizard.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.
